Frequently Asked Questions

What is snuff tobacco?

Snuff tobacco is a type of smokeless tobacco product made from finely ground or pulverized tobacco leaves. It is snorted or “sniffed” into the nasal cavity. Delivering a swift hit of nicotine and a lasting flavored scent.

What are the health effects of snuff smokeless tobacco?

Snuff smokeless tobacco has many health risks. It is not a safe alternative to smoking because it contains nicotine. This addictive chemical also found in other tobacco products has the following health effects;

- It contains at least 28 cancer-causing chemicals (carcinogens).

- Can cause gum disease, tooth decay, tooth loss, and the formation of white or gray patches inside the mouth called leukoplakia which can lead to cancer.

- Snuff smokeless tobacco use during pregnancy increases the risk of early delivery and stillbirth.

- Snuff smokeless tobacco is linked to several different types of cancer, including cancer of the mouth, esophagus, and pancreas.
